headline: The state of nature

items.title: John Locke, Second Treatise, §137
items.detail: To give a legislator absolute power is to put people into a worse condition than the state of nature, where they had a liberty to defend their right

items.title: They have disarmed themselves, and armed him
items.detail: The manuscript's quotation of that section

sources: Source: Locke, Second Treatise, Ch. XI, §137, Founders' Constitution transcription
